replacements.El modelo propone; el harness convierte: The model proposes; the harness turns proposals into repository work
replacements.La autonomía aparece cuando un runtime m: Autonomy emerges when a runtime maintains the loop, executes tools under policy, and decides when to verify, continue, or hand control back.
replacements.. El harness decide qué contexto recibe: . The harness decides what context the model receives, validates permissions, executes shell commands, edits, and git operations in a workspace, returns observations to the next turn, and preserves the causal continuity and state needed to repeat. A passing test or a reviewable diff is evidence for deciding whether the loop continues; neither is a property of the model by itself.
